description: Update campaign. Update a draft campaign. Only draft campaigns can be updated. Audience updates must use exactly one of property_ids, contact_ids, or list_ids. Sending steps replaces the whole step set, so include every step you want to keep. To add properties to a ready, active or paused campaign, use POST /campaigns/{id}/properties. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

steps.description: Replace the campaign mail steps (1-5). Steps are replaced as a set, so send every step you want to keep, not just the changed one.

delay_days.description: Days to wait after the previous step

design_prompt.description: Prompt to generate an HTML design on the fly

repeat_count.description: How many times to send this step (1-12)

skip_if_responded.description: Skip this step if the recipient has responded

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves this change or credit use.
